relationship_notes: Japanese handmade amp and effects builder. Current first-party catalog identifies TSpecial as a pedal based on the Overdrive Special drive channel and Magnus as a transparent-style fuzz. Current site also sells component-design variants such as TSpecial JRC4558 and Magnus NTE103A/NTE103B; those remain relationship-only. The wider AKG identity is strongly established as an amplifier builder, while the pedal-brand chronology is less extensively documented than the current product evidence.
